say:2:1041566201:1.text: Ah, if it isn't Sir Valen, General Hogan's trusted right hand. The very man overseeing the daily affairs of the Heroic Order.
say:2:1041566201:1.source_cn: 真巧，这不是替霍根将军暂时代管骑士团日常事务的维伦先生吗。

say:3:1041566202:1.text: Yes, hello. You can call me Valen. I could do without all the other stuff.
say:3:1041566202:1.source_cn: 确实，尽管我挺想反驳你那漫长的前缀的。

say:4:1041566203:1.text: If I had a choice, I would rather stay in this tavern forever and drink my worries away.
say:4:1041566203:1.source_cn: 如果能选的话，我倒是更愿意一直留在这酒馆里，愉快地喝上一杯。

say:5:1041566204:1.text: Oh, by the way, it's a pleasure to see you again, Miss Evie.
say:5:1041566204:1.source_cn: ——捎带一提，见到你很荣幸，伊芙小姐。

say:6:1041566205:1.text: If that's your idea of a greeting, I'd hate to see your goodbyes.
say:6:1041566205:1.source_cn: 这好像不适合作为寒暄的开场白啊。

say:7:1041566206:1.text: Well, we haven't had the need to exchange pleasantries so far.
say:7:1041566206:1.source_cn: 毕竟目前为止，我们也没有寒暄的必要。

say:8:1041566207:1.text: So, we haven't had the need to test each other, huh?
say:8:1041566207:1.source_cn: 那我们是不是也没有像这样互相试探的必要呢？

say:9:1041566208:1.text: Well, of course, miss. I'll always be polite until you or the lady you work for... reveal something to me.
say:9:1041566208:1.source_cn: 当然有，小姐。在您的那位大人尚未直接对我揭开她——或者...

say:10:1041566209:1.text: So being polite is just you beating around the bush?
say:10:1041566209:1.source_cn: 所以，你在把刺探和绕弯子作为礼貌？

say:11:1041566210:1.text: Compared to outright lies, I think beating around the bush is polite enough.
say:11:1041566210:1.source_cn: 比起确切不移的判断和大言不惭的谎言来说，这足够礼貌了，小姐。

say:12:1041566211:1.text: Oh please, at least I'm honest... unlike someone who plays the clueless playboy and wastes my time with nonsense.
say:12:1041566211:1.source_cn: 至少，我没有装作一无所知，伪装成一个浪荡子，说些浪费时...

say:13:1041566212:1.text: Aren't we both wasting our time with this nonsense now?
say:13:1041566212:1.source_cn: 我们现在在说的难道不是浪费时间的废话吗？
